author: mia
title: Vantro adds same-game multis for netball
dek: The bookmaker extends same-game multis beyond football codes for the first time.
body:
Vantro has added same-game multis to domestic netball matches, the first time the feature has been offered outside the football codes on its platform. The markets cover head to head, line and total goals. Player markets are not included at launch, and Vantro says it will review demand after the first season.

What is on offer

Customers can combine up to four legs from a single netball match. The available markets at launch are:

  • Head to head: which team wins the match.
  • Line: a team to win or lose by more or fewer than a set number of goals.
  • Total goals: over or under a figure for the match.
  • Quarter result: which team wins a given quarter.

Player markets, such as goals scored by a shooter, are not included. Vantro says it wants reliable player data before offering them.

How it works

Same-game multis combine several selections from one match into a single bet, and every leg must win. Because the outcomes are linked, the combined price is lower than the individual odds multiplied together. In netball, a team that wins comfortably is also likely to cover the line and push the total higher, so those legs are strongly connected.

Example legsOdds
Team A to win1.60
Team A −5.5 goals2.10
Total over 118.5 goals1.90
Multiplied together6.38
Same-game price offeredAbout 4.20

The figures are illustrative. Our explainer on same-game multis goes into why linked legs are priced this way and how the margin grows with each leg.

Why netball

Netball is one of Australia's most played team sports, and the domestic competition draws growing television audiences. Bookmakers have offered head-to-head and line markets for several seasons; same-game multis are the next step. Vantro says netball was chosen because its scoring is frequent and well recorded, which makes linked legs easier to price.

Limits and settings

The feature sits within Vantro's existing account tools. Deposit limits apply as usual, and customers can see recent same-game multi results in their monthly activity statement. A maximum stake applies to same-game multis on netball during the first season.

The takeaway

Same-game multis on netball give fans another way to follow a match, but the same rules apply as in football: linked legs pay less than they appear to, and every extra leg lowers the chance of winning. Keep stakes small and set your deposit limit before the season starts.
